[1/5] Plan: (1) replace the bottom-strip TRAINING chips with the commander's activatable abilities (icons, SHIFT+1..6 hotkeys, cooldown/ready state, click-to-use, charm target resolution); (2) make abilities progress (unlock charm/trade at skill 7, overclock becomes a timed reactor surge) and rebalance yields; (3) rebalance outpost yields/upgrades and early combat threat; (4) ADR-058 and README; (5) 100% tests, 4/4 gates, real-browser UI review by vision model

impact_assessment.why: The bottom-strip SKILLS panel trains passive ranks with SHIFT+1..6, but the design calls for the commander's activatable powers (Reactor Overclock, Emergency Repair, ...) with hotkeys; two of six abilities are unreachable, overclock is a duplicate of the reactor-mode button, and measured economy data shows outposts pay back in 1-1.5 months while early combat kills in 3 shots without hull damage.
impact_assessment.benefits: The cockpit's most-used strip becomes a tactical ability bar; all six powers are reachable through play; overclock is a unique burst; outposts become a longer-term investment than active play; early fights carry real risk; ability and outpost values are documented with measured numbers.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new ReactorState surge fields and ability-unlock thresholds must stay save-compatible; outpost and enemy stat changes shift documented balance; UI contract surface (static/server) changes; dependency: none beyond the standard library; concurrency: engine lock unchanged, no new threads; state: ReactorState gains defaulted fields, character abilities gain entries only
impact_assessment.mitigation: Backward-compatible defaults on every new field, or-from_dict tests for old saves, ability unlock additive to existing tuples, measured before/after simulation table in ADR-058, failing-first tests for each balance assertion, bounded UI diff inside the cockpit surface, full suite and 4/4 gates before any delivery

impact_assessment.why: A post-push audit found shield_absorb and evasive_burn bypassed the new defeat check, a dead ship could tick/repair back to life, reactor surge never expired during paused combat, CLI constructor skipped rank-7 reconciliation, and the death overlay could reopen over creation while hotkeys still fired behind it.
impact_assessment.benefits: 0 hull is now terminal everywhere, death cannot be undone by time or Repair, overclock is bounded during paused fights, legacy saves unlock through every entry path, and failures are visible and announced instead of silently logged.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: no new save fields; time pause is a normal state value; dependency: none; concurrency: engine lock unchanged; state: death pauses time and clears combat
impact_assessment.mitigation: Regression tests for lethal defensive actions, terminal tick, constructor unlock, per-turn surge decay and cockpit copy; full suite and 4/4 gates; real-browser vision audit before delivery

[1/6] Plan: (1) away-team mission catalog, deterministic outcome resolver, CrewMember xp/injury fields, AwayMission state with save-compatible defaults; (2) tick-driven completion, rewards, injuries, recovery, crew XP ranks, codex metric; (3) REST /api/away + launch/recall, CLI away, snapshot parity; (4) cockpit CREW-tab expedition section; (5) real-Edge vision review; (6) ADR/README/map + gates

impact_assessment.why: Crew are currently passive bonus sources with no decisions, injuries or progression, and planetary exploration ends after one land/salvage interaction. The game needs a repeatable risk/reward loop that turns crew composition and orbital position into choices without adding a new tab.
impact_assessment.benefits: Away teams give crew a purpose beyond passive stats, make injuries and medics matter, add a finite-time expedition loop with real failure costs, and feed existing research, contracts, factions, cargo, XP and codex systems.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new defaulted CrewMember.xp/injury_ticks and ShipState.away_missions fields, additive snapshot/REST; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: engine lock unchanged, tick resolves missions inside it; state: deterministic per save seed, active missions persist and are recalled safely
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pure deterministic resolver in a new module, backward-compatible from_dict tests, failing-first tests for launch/tick/injury/recall/parity, bounded UI diff, full suite and 4/4 gates, real-Edge captures reviewed by a vision subagent

impact_assessment.benefits: More systems/factions and pirate zones widen the map; blocking decisions create real-time tension; a mission board and counters reward play; quantum trade adds logistics; surface operations make landing a choice; devastation makes war consequential and population believable.
